evidence.detail: IFNULL(ROUND(...), '') AS win_percent — returns '' on divide-by-zero instead of NULL
c.win_percent = '' hardcoded on fake placeholder card
win_percent property is typed -> str and returns '' when no matches; should be float | None
{{win_percent}} — Mustache renders None/NULL as empty string, so templates require no change

triage.fix_sketch: 1) In decksite/data/card.py, decksite/data/archetype.py, decksite/data/person.py, analysis/analysis.py: strip the outer IFNULL(..., '') wrapper leaving ROUND((SUM(wins)/NULLIF(SUM(wins+losses),0))*100,1) — 9 SQL edits. 2) In decksite/data/card.py:332 change c.win_percent = '' to c.win_percent = None. 3) In decksite/data/matchup.py:26-27 change return type to float | None and return None instead of ''. 4) Check shared_web/static/js/metagamegrid.jsx:44-45 — n(archetype.winPercent) coerces null to 0, so add a null-guard like archetype.winPercent != null ? n(archetype.winPercent)+'%' : '—'.
triage.notes: The JSX null-guard is the one spot that could silently display '0.0%' instead of '—' if missed; everything else is mechanical. Mustache templates are safe with None.
